description: 1 free call per caller, then $0.001 USDC via x402 (paid in-band: params._meta["x402/payment"]). Base or Ethereum address -> profile in one call: EOA, contract or EIP-7702-delegated EOA; ETH balance; nonce (tx count); balances of major tokens (USDC, USDT, EURC, DAI, WETH, cbBTC/WBTC, USDbC); for contracts: bytecode size, EIP-1967/ZeppelinOS proxy implementation, beacon, owner(), ERC-20 name/symbol/decimals/supply and Sourcify verification. Public RPC data only. When to use: Use wallet-profile before sending funds to or trusting an address (is it a contract? does it hold USDC?). Use tx-explain for one transaction and contract-abi for the full interface of a contract.
name: wallet_profile
title: Wallet / Address Profile
